stem: The number of accidents on a certain road has a Poisson distribution with mean 0.4 per 50-day period.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that there will be fewer than 3 accidents during a year (365 days).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The probability that there will be no accidents during a period of $n$ days is greater than 0.95.

Find the largest possible value of $n$.
